authorization_basis.blocker: Existing frozen PIT signal coverage in main covers only 109 of 1355 official-domain earnings rows.

objective: Expand point-in-time prediction-market signal coverage for the frozen 1355 EARNINGS_EPS official-domain universe before any price/return/PnL execution.

join_keys_allowed: market_id/condition_id/token_id only when linked through frozen mapping evidence

allowed_signal_sources.condition: May be used only for point-in-time pre-cutoff probability/signal extraction, not outcome or return inspection.
Allowed only for historical pre-cutoff probability/price observations keyed to frozen event identifiers; settlement/outcome fields must not be read or stored.

selection_rule.signal_timestamp: latest available prediction-market probability observation at or before the frozen safe cutoff timestamp; if multiple valid observations exist, choose the latest pre-cutoff deterministically
selection_rule.probability_field: YES probability / YES price / normalized PM probability; field naming must be recorded in the signal map summary
selection_rule.fail_closed: Rows without deterministic mapping or pre-cutoff PIT signal remain uncovered with reason codes; no manual rescue is permitted after seeing returns.

minimum_outputs_before_pnl: expanded PIT signal map keyed by exact_group_id
signal source inventory and SHA256 fingerprints
coverage summary: base rows, mapped rows, unique ticker-dates, date range, failure reasons
firewall assertion showing no settlement/outcome/return/PNL reads
eligibility rerun using the expanded signal map
explicit decision whether N_final_backtestable_candidate_pre_price is large enough to justify economic execution

provisional_execution_threshold.rationale: The old completed financial backtest had 108 eligible opportunities; a materially expanded backtest should not be run and reported as expanded if signal coverage is only around the old sample size.
provisional_execution_threshold.policy: If coverage remains below this threshold, report the signal-coverage limitation instead of executing a small-N PnL as an expanded result.

next_required_artifacts: only then: price/return backtest execution authorization if coverage threshold is satisfied
